principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class violates the Open/Closed Principle because every time a new shape is added, the existing sum method needs to be altered to accommodate the new shape.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface for all shapes with a method to calculate the area. Then the AreaCalculator can simply call this method without being changed for new shapes.
